diagrams.title: State–projection–intent loop
diagrams.summary: The interface reads canonical state, projects it, and returns an intent to the competent authority.

nodes.label: Canonical state
nodes.description: The domain or runtime exposes a reading.

nodes.label: UI context
nodes.description: Preferences, locale, and reading level are combined.

nodes.label: Component projection
nodes.description: A shell, panel, or widget makes the reading perceptible.

nodes.label: User gesture
nodes.description: The interaction is translated into an intent.

nodes.label: Command
nodes.description: The authority admits, rejects, or transforms the request.

nodes.label: New reading
nodes.description: The interface observes the resulting state.

diagrams.caption: Movement, focus, and visual opening remain local unless they carry a semantic change.
